breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the inconsistency in line with the ground truth. The ground truth resolved the logical error (that B=3mm satisfies the criterion) by changing the thickness to B=6mm, which does satisfy the criterion. The agent, however, kept the incorrect value of B=3mm from the original prompt and instead added a calculation to show that the criterion was not met. This is not how the ground truth handled the issue.
